summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the Premium-at-limit UpgradeBanner variant. Backend: pytest suite (4/4 PASS) validates GET /api/me/subscription now returns `usage` field with correct shape, usage=null for free/admin/premium-seed users (documented behavior since seed premium has no real Stripe sub), tiers block preserved with premium/vip amount+monthly_upload_limit, endpoint latency <300ms. Frontend: (a) Free user (free@elitescout.com) sees the default banner with data-testid='dashboard-upgrade-banner', both Premium+VIP mini-cards side-by-side (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2), correct headline/eyebrow copy. (b) Premium-at-limit variant tested via Playwright page.route interception mocking /api/me/subscription with usage.exhausted=true — banner switches to data-testid='dashboard-upgrade-banner-at-limit', Premium card hidden, VIP card only, grid becomes grid-cols-1, all target copy present ('Need more uploads? Go VIP.', 'Premium limit reached · 5 / 5 this month', "You've used all 5 Premium uploads this month..."). Regression: Reports library, Players list, Quick Stats row all render; SubscriptionCard also renders in mocked premium state; zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx is 827 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting UpgradeBanner and SubscriptionCard into their own files to keep DashboardPage focused on layout+data fetching. Pre-existing.

The usage.exhausted computation and the /me/upload-eligibility endpoint independently do the same count_documents({user_id, created_at>=period_start}) query. Consider consolidating into a single reusable helper to keep the two code paths in sync if billing period logic ever changes.
test_credentials: free@elitescout.com / Free@2026 (real backend). Premium-at-limit tested via Playwright route mock — no real Stripe interaction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Premium-at-limit banner variant (data-testid='dashboard-upgrade-banner-at-limit') can ONLY be seen with a user whose /api/me/subscription returns subscription.tier='premium' + subscription.status='active' + usage.exhausted=true. The test premium seed (premium@elitescout.com) is a legacy prepay-unlock account and does NOT trigger this state — backend correctly returns subscription:null + usage:null for it. Future tests must use Playwright page.route mocking (as done here) or wait until the app has a real premium subscriber with 5/5 uploads consumed. Grid classes to assert: free='grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2', at-limit='grid-cols-1' (no sm: breakpoint). Note that CSS text-transform:uppercase means Playwright innerText assertions must be case-insensitive.
